== Card credits ==
Morten Iversen is credited with the original concept of two Players Committee [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The concept credit names where the concept was won: Danish Nationals 2011. The cards are in [[Virtual Block 7]] (released 2010–2011) and [[Virtual Set 9]] (released 6 July 2018).

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! Set !! Released !! Credit as printed
|-
| [[Shadows Of The Empire|•Shadows Of The Empire]] || [[Virtual Set 9]] || 6 July 2018 || "Original concept by Morten Iversen"
|-
| [[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7)|•Shadows Of The Empire]] || [[Virtual Block 7]] || 2010–2011 || "Original concept by Morten Iversen, Danish Nationals 2011"
|}

The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Morten Iversen|Morten Iversen]] on [[Card Credits]].
